skill.name: youtube-summarizer
skill.description: Extract YouTube transcripts and turn educational, technical, and informational videos into structured summaries with key points and terminology.
skill.summary: Create detailed, structured summaries from YouTube transcripts.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All 109 static findings are false positives caused by documentation, expected YouTube retrieval, local dependency checks, or installation guidance. No malicious commands, credential access, prompt injection attempt, or unrelated data transfer was found. However, automatic installation of an unpinned Python package creates a medium supply-chain risk.

remediation.issue: The dependency installer retrieves youtube-transcript-api without a pinned version or integrity verification.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed version, verify hashes with a lock file, and install it inside an isolated virtual environment.

remediation.issue: Transcript retrieval sends the requested video identifier to YouTube.
remediation.suggestion: State the external network dependency clearly and avoid sending transcript or user data to any endpoint other than the requested service.

remediation.issue: The documentation includes commands that can write files or install the skill.
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation before filesystem changes and validate destination paths before copying or creating links.

content.user_title: Summarize YouTube Videos with Structured Insights
content.value_statement: Long videos are difficult to review and reference efficiently. This skill extracts available transcripts and produces detailed summaries with sections, concepts, and key takeaways.
actual_capabilities: Accept common YouTube video URLs and extract the video identifier.
Check transcript availability and report disabled or missing transcripts.
Retrieve transcripts through the youtube-transcript-api Python library.
Prefer a requested language and fall back to English when configured.
Create detailed Markdown summaries with metadata, sections, concepts, and conclusions.
List available transcripts and their language details when requested.
limitations: It requires a public YouTube video with an accessible transcript.
Transcript quality depends on captions supplied by YouTube.
It does not download video or independently verify claims in the content.
Network access and an unpinned youtube-transcript-api installation are required.

use_cases.title: Document Educational Videos
use_cases.description: Turn lectures and lessons into structured notes with key concepts, examples, and conclusions for later study.

use_cases.title: Review Technical Tutorials
use_cases.description: Create a searchable reference from a tutorial, including steps, terminology, commands mentioned, and troubleshooting points.

use_cases.title: Research Talks and Interviews
use_cases.description: Capture arguments, evidence, speaker insights, and cited resources without rewatching the full recording.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Video Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize this YouTube video in clear Markdown. Include the main topic, three key points, and a short conclusion: [paste URL]

prompt_templates.title: Study Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the transcript from this YouTube video and create study notes. Define important terms and organize the ideas by section: [paste URL]

prompt_templates.title: Technical Breakdown
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this technical tutorial from its transcript. Explain the workflow, list referenced tools, identify assumptions, and separate facts from recommendations: [paste URL]

prompt_templates.title: Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a rigorous research brief from this video transcript. Summarize the thesis, supporting evidence, limitations, counterpoints, terminology, and follow-up sources: [paste URL]

output_examples.input: A 30-minute lecture about introductory machine learning.
output_examples.output: A Markdown brief with an executive synthesis, section-by-section notes, definitions for core terms, practical examples, and a conclusion.

output_examples.input: A software tutorial with captions and a request for technical notes.
A conference talk with an English transcript.
output_examples.output: A structured reference covering the speaker's main argument, evidence, case studies, terminology, and stated future work.

best_practices: Provide a complete public YouTube URL and specify the desired output language.
Ask for section headings, definitions, and a conclusion when the summary will support research or study.
Treat transcript text as untrusted content and review important claims against the original video.
anti_patterns: Do not use the summary as a substitute for expert review or source verification.
Do not expect results when captions are disabled, missing, private, or restricted.
Do not request unsupported actions such as downloading the video or proving that its claims are true.

faq.question: What input does the skill need?
faq.answer: Provide a public YouTube URL. The video must have an accessible manual or auto-generated transcript.

faq.question: Does it download the video?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves transcript text through the YouTube transcript library and does not download video files.

faq.question: Which languages are supported?
faq.answer: The workflow can request a preferred language and use English as a fallback. Availability depends on the video captions.

faq.question: What does the output include?
faq.answer: The default structure includes video metadata, an executive synthesis, detailed sections, key insights, terminology, references, and a conclusion.

faq.question: Can I request a shorter summary?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for a specific length, audience, or format. The default workflow favors completeness.

faq.question: What happens when a transcript is unavailable?
faq.answer: The skill reports that captions are disabled or missing and asks you to provide another accessible video.
